# 12V LiFePO4 Battery (12vlifepo4battery.com)

Entity statement: This site tracks 12V LiFePO4 battery prices from the manufacturers' own online stores and ranks every tracked model by price per watt-hour ($/Wh): the maker's listed price divided by the battery's rated capacity in watt-hours (nominal voltage x amp-hours). Prices are refreshed several times a day; listings are data, not hands-on reviews. Sister trackers cover 48V LiFePO4, 24V LiFePO4 and server-rack batteries.

## Core and capacity pages
- [12V LiFePO4 Battery Prices Compared by $/Wh — Live Price Tracker](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/): Compare 93 12V LiFePO4 battery models by price per watt-hour. Prices from the makers' own stores, refreshed November 25, 2026.
- [12V 100Ah LiFePO4 Batteries — Prices by $/Wh](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/12v-100ah-lifepo4-battery/): The most popular size on the market — every 100Ah model by $/Wh. Prices from the makers' own stores, refreshed November 25, 2026.
- [12V 200Ah LiFePO4 Batteries — Prices by $/Wh](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/12v-200ah-lifepo4-battery/): Double-capacity 200Ah-class packs — usually cheaper per Wh than 100Ah. Prices from the makers' own stores, refreshed November 25, 2026.
- [12V 314Ah LiFePO4 Batteries — Prices by $/Wh](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/12v-314ah-lifepo4-battery/): The $/Wh leaders: 314Ah packs storing 4kWh in a single case. Prices from the makers' own stores, refreshed November 25, 2026.
- [100Ah LiFePO4 Battery: 12V, 24V and 48V Compared by $/Wh](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/100ah-lifepo4-battery/): A 100Ah LiFePO4 battery is three different products depending on voltage — 1,280Wh, 2,560Wh or 5,120Wh. Live 12V prices ranked by $/Wh, refreshed November 25, 2026.

## Use-case pages
- [12V LiFePO4 Batteries for RVs — Prices by $/Wh](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/rv-batteries/): Batteries marketed for RV and camper use, ranked by $/Wh. Prices from the makers' own stores, refreshed November 25, 2026.
- [12V LiFePO4 Trolling Motor & Marine Batteries — Prices by $/Wh](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/marine-trolling-motor-batteries/): Lightweight 12V packs for trolling motors and boats, by $/Wh. Prices from the makers' own stores, refreshed November 25, 2026.
- [12V LiFePO4 Batteries for Solar: Panel-to-Battery Sizing, Live Prices](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/12v-lifepo4-battery-for-solar/): Which 12V LiFePO4 batteries makers sell for solar, how much panel a 100Ah battery can absorb, and live $/Wh prices — refreshed November 25, 2026.
- [How Long Will a 12V 100Ah Battery Run a Fridge? The Honest Math](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/how-long-will-12v-100ah-run-a-fridge/): Runtime depends on the fridge, not the battery: duty-cycle math for home fridges, 12V compressor fridges and mini fridges on 1,280Wh — plus the batteries, priced live.
- [12V Battery for CPAP Camping: Nights per Charge, by Humidifier Setting](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/12v-battery-for-cpap/): A CPAP's battery appetite is set by its heater, not its motor: runtime tables for therapy-only, humidifier and heated-tube settings on 100Ah and 200Ah, priced live.
- [LiFePO4 Battery for Ice Fishing: Cold Rules, Sonar Loads, Shuttle Sizes](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/ice-fishing-battery-guide/): Ice fishing runs on small batteries in deep cold: what a flasher, a forward-facing sonar and shanty lights actually draw per day, which pack size covers it, and the below-freezing charging rule.
- [Van Life Battery Sizing: The Load-Audit Worksheet, Worked in Amp-Hours](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/van-life-battery-sizing/): Van battery sizing fails on guessed loads, not bad batteries: audit a day's real watt-hours, divide by usable capacity, land on 100Ah, 200Ah or 314Ah — priced live, refreshed November 25, 2026.

## Guides and comparisons
- [How to Choose a 12V LiFePO4 Battery — Prices by $/Wh](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/how-to-choose/): Size, BMS, low-temp protection and $/Wh — the checks that matter. Prices from the makers' own stores, refreshed November 25, 2026.
- [LiTime vs Renogy 12V 100Ah: Live Prices, Lineup Depth, $/Wh](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/litime-vs-renogy-12v-100ah/): The two deepest 12V catalogs head to head in the 100Ah class — live $/Wh, cheapest models and lineup depth from maker-store prices, refreshed November 25, 2026.
- [12V LiFePO4 Charging Guide: 14.4V Profile, Charge Times, Cold Rules](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/12v-lifepo4-charging-guide/): How to charge a 12V LiFePO4 battery correctly: 14.2–14.6V absorption, no float requirement, no equalization — plus charge-time math by charger size.
- [Eco-Worthy vs LiTime 12V LiFePO4: Depth vs the $/Wh Floor, Live Prices](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/eco-worthy-vs-litime-12v/): Eco-Worthy tracks 4 12V models; LiTime tracks 52. The head-to-head on live $/Wh, the two capacity classes they share, and what lineup depth is worth — refreshed November 25, 2026.
- [12V LiFePO4 in Series & Parallel: The 4-in-Series Ceiling, Wiring, Matching Rules](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/12v-lifepo4-series-parallel-guide/): How series and parallel wiring actually work for 12V LiFePO4: series adds volts (four 12V packs = a 48V system), parallel adds amp-hours, the 4-in-series ceiling most models carry, and the matching rules that keep a bank balanced.
- [LiFePO4 vs Lead-Acid Cost: Cost per Delivered kWh, Not Sticker Price](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/lifepo4-vs-lead-acid-cost/): The lead-acid battery is cheaper to buy and roughly ten times more expensive to use. Cost-per-cycle math for a 12V 100Ah swap, with the LiFePO4 side priced live — refreshed November 25, 2026.
- [12V LiFePO4 Voltage Chart: State of Charge from 13.6V Full to 10V Empty](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/12v-lifepo4-voltage-chart/): A 12V LiFePO4 voltage chart from a maker's published figures: rested voltage at every 10% of charge, why the middle of the curve is flat, and what to trust instead of a meter. Prices refreshed November 25, 2026.
- [What Size Inverter for a 12V LiFePO4 Battery? The BMS Amp Rule](https://12vlifepo4battery.com/what-size-inverter-for-12v-lifepo4-battery/): How to size an inverter for a 12V LiFePO4 battery: the BMS continuous current times 12.8V sets the ceiling, plus surge, cable and the point where 12V stops making sense. Live 12V prices refreshed November 25, 2026.
